title: $T$-admissible processes and noncommutative weighted ergodic theorems
summary: In this article, we study the bilaterally almost uniform (b.a.u.) convergence of weighted averages of a positive Dunford-Schwartz operator on the noncommutative $L_p$-spaces associated to a semifinite von Neumann algebra by a large number of weighting sequences. We do this by extending the classical "subsequence argument" to the noncommutative setting. This is then used to establish a large number of sequences satisfying a certain decay condition as good weights for the noncommutative individual ergodic theorem.
